author: SickProdigy
description: Find online memes and GIFs, publish scheduled feeds, and caption local images.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store user data, submitted caption text, avatars, or generated images.
install_msg: Use `[p]meme` for online memes, `[p]meme gif` for animated Imgur results, and `[p]memeify` (alias `[p]imgflip`) for local captioning. Online providers require optional Red shared API tokens; see the cog README.
name: Meme
